label: Requires manual setup

issues.message: Isolated MOSS-Music audio runtime and model snapshot: Run setup_runtime.py --install-environment to build/check a patched candidate; install MOSS assets with its configured Python. Package network access is required; see docs/RUNTIME_UPGRADE.md.
A local Ollama service with ornith-1.5:35b is required: Import the pinned GGUF using docs/ollama/Modelfile; the alias is not assumed to exist in the Ollama registry.

note: Recipients still need compatible ComfyUI, hardware, and access to any gated models.
